name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Compact tram-based terminus retry with native track spacing and smooth crossover joins.
description: Revision 17 follows the tram-first design correction: removes sleeper-track pieces and railway buffers, keeps 5m tram track spacing without flaring and reduces the entry/switch area from 130m to 40m while retaining 80m platforms. Two side platforms replace the broad island. Bare rail-only game meshes are embedded in paving and are purely decorative. Previous revision placed and each approach could reach its own platform both ways, but no cross-platform route was found. This version gives the crossover horizontal endpoint tangents matching both main tracks. That addresses an identified geometric kink; native cross-platform routing remains unproven. Place one NEW Twin Terminus on a test copy and run ten seconds. Existing placed stations are not automatically resized or migrated. Core tram profiles and the working baseline remain unchanged.
